archive.catalogue_description: Description One year ago, I made this map with some friends and it was a lot of fun Because of school work, I had to leave zombiemodding This map took 7 months to make it and I think it became really good as my first and probably last map. Today I realised that I’ve never uploaded my map here, so I’m proud to present you Schule Der Toten. There are a lot easter egg songs, the most of them are made by Dj Almix, so big thanks to him. I hope you will have fun defeating the undead! FEATURES -Custom menu (Thx to Rampage_619, treminaor and Tom_Bmx ) – Kino teleporter (Thx to ADDICTED and Tom_Bmx) -Zappers (Thx to ADDICTED and Tom_Bmx) -BO perks (Thx to bamskater33 and OnlineX420) -Vulure-aid and Electric Cherry (Thx to bamskater33) -Buyable Ending (Thx to Tom_Bmx) -Custom powerups (Thx to http://www.thetechgame.com/ (scripts) and KDXDARK from ugx-mods) -Adapted Five Teleporters (Thx to Pie man) -Power-Up machine (Thx to bamskater33) -Lunar Lander (Thx to bamskater33) -Boss with meter (Thx to Paraglor and losangeles26) -Custom perk shaders (Thx to Deadnaut) EASTER EGGS – WOOSH (Thx to MakeCents, JBird632, bamskater33) -? ??(Thx to bamskater33, Phil, Jonas, TheGtlad and thebeast2365) -3.(Thx to bamskater33) -BB and Boss (Zomb1e-KLLR) VERY SPECIAL THANKS TO Dj Almix (He made our music + he is awesome ) Tanno Quintens (web designer) Jesper Van Caeter AKA Thejipppp (scripter + mapper) and Brian Coppens AKA Hellkid_6969 (mapper) Lucien De Leeuw AKA DrWeB-Jr (promotor + betatester + desig

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it.
